source.label: NCI SEER Explorer: risk of diagnosis, November 2025 submission
source.definition: Probability of first diagnosis of the specified cancer among persons alive and free of that cancer at the starting age, with competing mortality.

diseases.label: Aggressive prostate cancer
diseases.unsupported_reason: No directly published SEER age-specific finite-interval risk matches aggressive prostate cancer. Enter the aggressive prostate cancer incidence risk (%) for the selected starting age and follow-up. General prostate cancer risk is not substituted.
diseases.definition: Study-defined aggressive prostate cancer; no matching age-specific finite-interval risk series is published in the reviewed SEER products.

missing_value_meaning: No exact published SEER estimate for this disease, sex, race, starting age and finite interval. Never interpret an absent record or blank cell as zero.
both_sexes_definition: Direct SEER both-sex estimate; not a 50:50 arithmetic average.
cutoff_rule: starting age + follow-up years <= 90; longer requested intervals are unavailable, not truncated.
